sourceProof.interval: Every reading/grab card, first-glyph replica, art and impact line remains primary. Exponential sine bump never becomes static after .28: exp(-14t)*sin(40t)*.02 is enclosed for all t>=0 by anisotropic sx/sy in [.98,1.02]. Exact current anisotropic scale and rotation are inverted before sweeping each owned point over full angular and native .7W entry/.15H exit displacement intervals. Impact supports follow their source center and bounded radial endpoints. Original joint translation precedes proportional paper/font size and paper-height reflow candidates. Full entry-stage fit is currently conservative: insufficient results do not assert physical impossibility or certify native entry-crop dominance.
sourceProof.stageProof: Exact inverse current anisotropic bump/rotation followed by independent complete sx/sy, angular and entry/exit displacement intervals; full four-corner axis bounds include every card, real glyph replica and source impact. Fullstage fit remains conservative and does not exempt native entry crop.
sourceProof.limitations: Cut/still text motion only; unsupported source domains fail explicitly
